hero.title: Activities to book
hero.description: Experiences that need a reservation or tickets in advance. Day-by-day ideas are in the itinerary.

activities.title: Taipei 101 Observatory
activities.description: Timed tickets online to skip the line. Aim for late afternoon and the sunset.

activities.title: National Palace Museum
activities.description: The world's largest collection of Chinese art. Online tickets recommended on weekends.

activities.title: Jiufen & Shifen day trip
activities.description: Jiufen village + Shifen lanterns. Organized tour (easier) or DIY by bus/train.

activities.title: THSR early bird (day trips)
activities.description: Discounted THSR tickets 28 days ahead for the Taipei and Taichung days.
